background.job: Where the scene takes place. Chosen once for the module.

authoring._note: Prose, read by the model only. Fenced as data; runtime rules win.
authoring.location: The scene stays where it is for the whole module. If a module opens somewhere new, the first line acknowledges the move in fiction — a character suggests it and the other agrees. Never change location mid-module, and never move without saying why.
